description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces for the CCSP Message Bus Service, including function prototypes for message bus engagement, initialization, finalization, resource management, and message handling, used in embedded Linux environments.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a bus check with user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources with specified priority and user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating a parameter value has changed.

methods.name: CcspPandM_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles messages received on the DBus path.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers the interface to the configuration repository.
